mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, course_id, plan_start_date, plan_end_date, actual_start_date, actual_end_date, status, training_location, instructor, participant_count, description, url, file_name, content_type, file_size, file_suffix, create_by_id, create_by, create_time, update_by_id, update_by, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT ti.id, ti.tenant_id, ti.course_id, ti.plan_start_date, ti.plan_end_date, ti.actual_start_date, ti.actual_end_date, ti.status, ti.training_location, ti.instructor, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shkb_training_participant tp WHERE tp.implementation_id = ti.id AND tp.deleted = 0) AS participant_count, ti.description, ti.url, ti.file_name, ti.content_type, ti.file_size, ti.file_suffix, ti.create_by_id, ti.create_by, ti.create_time, ti.update_by_id, ti.update_by, ti.update_time, ti.deleted, tc.course_name, tc.course_type, tc.training_hours FROM shkb_training_implementation ti LEFT JOIN shkb_training_course tc ON ti.course_id = tc.id WHERE ti.id = #{id} AND ti.deleted = 0
